notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/c1ab0dea51523a1f67218ab84ad8383544b11d90.png
It has been a long time since I have last posted. Right now a new game is in the works - being designed first for mobile market and then PC release.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/c19334fececbecfcc8fc4d3aad2e3d97fe932421.png
Think Binding of Isaac combined with animals. I hope to launch a Kickstarter in the near future once I have more to share - most likely when I have a mobile demo that can be played for free. (that is the plan right now)

Regarding the Disturbed Series... Disturbed Beyond Aramor sits at 5 reviews and is $5. Taking account of the return from investment, I will not be doing anymore 'Disturbed' content. I will continue to post announcements here, but if you are interested in future projects/releases, please follow me through Steam and/or follow my Facebook page. Thank you. :theskull:
https://www.facebook.com/iblackpen

notes.title: Updating Disturbed to a newer version
notes.notes:
Now that Disturbed: Beyond Aramor is out, it is time to update the game that started it all.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/617620/Disturbed_Beyond_Aramor/

Due to the outdated version of the engine Disturbed runs on, players have had problems playing the Linux version of the game. This updated version should fix this problem, while also breathing some life back into the game with updated visuals. Progress has only just begun, but hopefully within the next month or two, this update will be ready and available for all to enjoy. More updates to come! :dba_Sacred:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/88754b8ff6dc57c72da7f30ae54e7c3ff014485a.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/cf9cb3aa89a73c11d58d64a4b471c41ca069fb1f.png

notes.title: An update regarding Disturbed 2
notes.notes:
I want to take a moment to make a post regarding the state of Disturbed 2. How things are going, the release date is looking to be in March. I hope to have a solid date by February. As of things right now, the game's story is undergoing refinements and testing. Much of the artwork still needs to be animated, but I hope that this can all be done and polished by the end of February. It is exciting to have things come together, and it will be really interesting to see how people will handle it.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/50a11e286f0bbf27fc040e2de3c9a99d001c646d.jpg

I had very high ambitions at the start of this project and I didn't really know what I was doing. I didn't want to replicate the same Disturbed experience without adding to it, so I let my imagination go wild... and it kinda took over. I went through several story changes and as I wrote, I kept adding to it. I realize now, looking back, how important it is to set parameters and to keep things simple. I feel I wasted a lot of time experimenting with things when I should have focused my time elsewhere. The reason I share this is that the advertised story and gameplay is a little different than I was hoping for. Over the next couple weeks, I plan on having the store page updated with new (and better) screenshots and descriptions that will be more accurate. Regarding the translations for the game, these may be delayed depending on how things go. Due to the project taking way longer than planned, I can't make any guarantees.

https://68.media.tumblr.com/1f6d5bc153e6e6d904a14e2b981d233b/tumblr_p2rob7lrWo1v8u3k8o1_1280.gif

I want to thank those who have encouraged me to keep going, along with those who have bought the 'support dlc'. I appreciate the time people have taken to review Disturbed and to share their thoughts. My goal with this next game is to embrace the experience of adventure with a heavy emphasis on exploring the environment. Stay tuned for more updates as the game comes closer to completion.

Thank you. ːwarhorseː

notes.title: Schedule Update
notes.notes:
I've had a bad habit of keeping quiet these past couple months. I do think it is good to be a little transparent - not too much, but enough to let people know that stuff is happening. ːwarhorseː

Here is coming within the next few weeks!

Updated Website ːcsgoxː
The new site should be up by 2/24.
http://iblackpen.com/

Disturbed Supporter DLC
Although this won't add to the game, it has been requested many times over the past few months to offer it. This will be added within the first week of March.

Disturbed 2 Announcement
The development of the sequel is going well. I am reaching a point where I can prepare something like a Greenlight campaign. With Steam's announcement regarding Greenlight, I see little harm in putting the game up anyways. My goal is to have things ready and up by March 12th at the latest.
http://68.media.tumblr.com/c5539b554fb387c044b7e49b4978dd05/tumblr_oln02vB46n1v8u3k8o2_1280.jpg
